title: Probabilistic Causal Panel Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.36176v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many causal panel estimators construct counterfactuals using weights or latent structure estimated directly from observed outcomes, making treatment-effect estimates sensitive to observation noise. Bayesian hierarchical models can account for this noise and borrow information across related observations, but existing Bayesian approaches to causal panel analysis generally combine outcome modeling and counterfactual imputation in estimator-specific formulations that can require bespoke sampling algorithms. We develop a framework that learns the latent untreated panel with a probabilistic model and applies established causal estimators to its posterior draws. The model accommodates non-Gaussian observations and structured pooling, while re-estimation across draws propagates uncertainty through counterfactual imputation. translated_abstract: 许多因果面板估计器使用直接从观测结果中估计的权重或潜在结构来构建反事实，这使得处理效应估计对观测噪声敏感。贝叶斯分层模型可以考虑这种噪声并在相关观测之间借用信息，但现有的因果面板分析贝叶斯方法通常在估计器特定的公式中将结果建模与反事实填补相结合，这可能需要定制的采样算法。我们开发了一个框架，该框架使用概率模型学习潜在的未处理面板，并将已有的因果估计器应用于其后验抽样中。该模型可容纳非高斯观测和结构化池化，同时在各次后验抽样中重新估计会通过反事实填补传播不确定性。我们建立了反事实填补后验一致性的条件，并刻画了池化如何影响填补质量……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个概率框架，先用概率模型学习潜在的未处理面板数据，再对后验抽样应用已有的因果估计器，从而在容纳非高斯观测和结构化池化的同时，将不确定性通过反事实填补传播到处理效应估计中。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a probabilistic framework that learns the latent untreated panel via a probabilistic model and applies established causal estimators to its posterior draws, propagating uncertainty through counterfactual imputation while accommodating non-Gaussian observations and structured pooling.
